steps: Join free at rewardxp.com via email (collect the small 5 XP welcome bonus).
Open the games section and choose a featured mobile or browser game; read the milestone requirements on the offer before starting.
Play until you hit each milestone — XP is awarded per completed milestone (100 XP = $1.00).
Build your balance to at least 500 XP ($5).
Redeem via PayPal, Venmo, Visa cash, a gift card, or crypto — most rewards are paid within minutes to two hours.
